scheme_name: Coir Vikas Yojana- Coir Industry Technology Upgradation Scheme
other_conditions: The unit must be a newly established coir production/processing unit or an existing unit seeking modernization/upgradation
The unit must be registered with the Coir Board under Coir Industry (Registration) Rules, 2008 and possess a Udyog Aadhar
Entrepreneurs must not have availed any Central Government subsidy under PMEGP, CUY, DPI, TUF, etc., for the same purpose
For modernization assistance, the unit must have completed five years of successful operation after commencement of production
The project cost must fall within the investment limits prescribed for Small and Medium Enterprises under the MSME Act
All equipment and machinery must comply with standards prescribed by BIS and price ceilings set by the Technical Committee
Machinery can be imported only with justified reason and must be accompanied by invoice, shipping bill and performance certificate
A single unit/enterprise is not eligible for grant of assistance under the scheme
Units exceeding the investment limits for medium‑scale enterprises are not eligible
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to 25% of plant and machinery cost, capped at ₹2.5 crore per unit, provided as reimbursement through DBT/PFMS.
documents_required: Detailed Project Report (DPR) in prescribed format
In‑Principle Approval (IPA) from the Coir Board
Coir Board registration of the unit
